scripts.build: bun ../../scripts/run-if-sources.ts build -- bun --eval "if (await Bun.file('./src/index.ts').exists()) { const proc = Bun.spawn(['bun', 'build', './src/index.ts', '--outdir', 'dist', '--target', 'bun'], { stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }); process.exit(await proc.exited); } else { console.log('No CLI entrypoint found; skipping build'); }"
